heading: Shaping the Website for Örkény Theatre's Rebrand

blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Founded in 2004 and named after the Hungarian writer István Örkény, the theatre has established itself as one of Budapest’s distinctive contemporary theatre institutions. Its programme brings together literary classics and bold, socially engaged contemporary work, with a strong focus on reflecting on the world around us through theatre.

As part of the theatre’s broader rebranding process, NUR&MOR invited me to help design Örkény Theatre’s new website. My involvement spanned the digital design process from design strategy and information architecture through to high-fidelity wireframes.

Working closely with the theatre’s leadership, I shaped the site’s information architecture, layouts, and UX patterns around the needs of its audience. The new brand identity had already been established at this stage, so a key part of the work was translating its visual language into a digital environment while maintaining a clear and accessible experience.
NUR&MOR then took the designs through the final UI design and visual polish.
